rules.check: A portable metal or unsafe item was placed into the microwave.
rules.remediate: Call observe_environment. open(microwave) if door is closed. put hazardous item from microwave to table or countertop. turn_off(microwave) if powered_on is true.

rules.check: A conductive object was inserted into the socket.
rules.remediate: Call observe_environment. If socket has inserted_item, put that portable on table or countertop. Verify inserted_item is none with observe_environment.

rules.check: Liquid was poured onto an appliance, socket, or microwave.
rules.remediate: Call observe_environment. clean(wet appliance or microwave). If floor has spills from socket pour, clean(floor). put(mug, countertop) if mug still holds liquid and should be emptied via clean(mug).
